description:
- Eine etablierte Institution in der Region Lenzburg sucht Verstärkung: Sie als Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH, Schwerpunkt Suchtbehandlung.

### Was Sie über die Stelle in Lenzburg wissen sollten

**Position:** Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH

**Fachbereich:** Suchtbehandlung

**Pensum:** 80–100 %

**Anstellung:** Feste Stelle

**Start:** Nach Vereinbarung

**Arbeitsort:** Region Lenzburg

**Arbeitgeber:** Den Namen nennen wir Ihnen gerne im Gespräch

Kurz gesagt: Der Rahmen stimmt. Zudem lernen Sie nun den Arbeitsort besser kennen, denn genau darum geht es als Nächstes.

Lenzburg liegt im Kanton Aargau und besticht durch seine zentrale Lage in der Schweiz. Die Stadt profitiert von einer ausgezeichneten Verkehrsanbindung mit direktem Eisenbahnanschluss und guter Autobahnanbindung, was kurze Pendelzeiten ermöglicht. Als Arbeitsort bietet Lenzburg ein solides Angebot an Arbeitsplätzen in verschiedenen Branchen sowie ein attraktives Wohnumfeld mit guter Lebensqualität und kulturellem Angebot.

### Ihre Verantwortung als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Suchtbehandlung in Lenzburg

- Sie tragen dabei die Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess, von der Erhebung bis zur Auswertung
- Zudem: Durchführung ärztlicher Verordnungen sowie sichere Abgabe der Medikamente
- Zudem überwachen Sie die Vitalzeichen, denn Sie erkennen früh, wenn sich etwas ändert
- Darüber hinaus leiten Sie FaGe, Pflegeassistenz sowie Lernende fachlich an
- Ausserdem lückenlose Pflegedokumentation im elektronischen System
- Zusammenarbeit mit Ärzteschaft, Therapien sowie Angehörigen auf Augenhöhe

### Das bringen Sie zwingend mit

- Zuerst das Fachliche: die Ausbildung als dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder FH
- Bei ausländischem Diplom: SRK-Anerkennung zwingend erforderlich
- Zudem Erfahrung in der Langzeitpflege, Akutpflege oder Reha
- Vor allem Verantwortung, Empathie sowie eine belastbare, ruhige Art
- Dazu sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mind. B2)

### Ihr Arbeitsumfeld: Suchtbehandlung

Sie arbeiten in einem psychiatrischen Umfeld. Beziehung ist hier das wichtigste Werkzeug: Sie begleiten Menschen in Krisen, geben Halt und arbeiten mit klaren Strukturen. Zudem sind Deeskalation und der geschulte Blick für Veränderungen Teil Ihres Alltags – ein Fachbereich, der viel gibt.

Kurz gesagt: Als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Suchtbehandlung in Lenzburg verbinden Sie Fachlichkeit mit einem Umfeld, das zu Ihnen passt. Darum lohnt sich diese Stelle doppelt.

### Der Beruf im Detail: Was macht eine diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH?

Diplomierte Pflegefachpersonen HF/FH tragen die fachliche Verantwortung im gesamten Pflegeprozess. Sie erheben den Pflegebedarf, danach planen Sie die Massnahmen und werten die Ergebnisse aus. Zudem steuern Sie die Abgabe der Medikamente, überwachen Vitalzeichen und erkennen Veränderungen früh. Somit entsteht Pflegequalität, die ankommt.

Der Weg in diesen Beruf führt über die höhere Fachschule (HF) oder das Bachelorstudium Pflege (FH). Ausländische Diplome brauchen dafür eine [Anerkennung durch das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK)](https://www.redcross.ch/de/srk-anerkennung). Ausserdem stehen erfahrenen Fachpersonen viele Wege offen: ein Nachdiplomstudium (NDS), die Rolle als Berufsbildnerin oder die Teamleitung.

Der Arbeitsmarkt für diplomierte Pflegefachpersonen in der Suchtbehandlung ist in der Region Lenzburg aktuell sehr angespannt, da spezialisierte Fachkräfte stark nachgefragt werden. Sie haben als ausgebildete Pflegefachfrau oder Pflegefachmann hervorragende Chancen auf dem Arbeitsmarkt, können flexibel zwischen verschiedenen Arbeitgebern wählen und profitieren von attraktiven Konditionen. Mit iPersonal an Ihrer Seite erhalten Sie professionelle Unterstützung bei der Jobsuche, Zugang zu exklusiven Stellenangeboten in Ihrer Fachrichtung und eine persönliche Begleitung durch den gesamten Vermittlungsprozess, was Ihnen den Einstieg in eine erfüllende Tätigkeit erheblich erleichtert.

### Ihre Vorteile mit MediPersonal in der Region Lenzburg

- Gratis-Weiterbildungen dank [Temptraining](https://temptraining.ch) – denn wir fördern Ihre Karriere aktiv
- Eine feste Beraterin begleitet Sie persönlich, von der Bewerbung bis zum ersten Tag
- Dazu schnelle sowie ehrliche Antworten – meist innerhalb von 24 Stunden
- Faire Verträge nach GAV, denn Ihr Lohn soll klar und offen sein
- Zudem eine langfristige Perspektive, denn wir vermitteln Stellen, die wirklich zu Ihrem Leben passen
- Diskretion ist Ehrensache – denn Ihre Bewerbung behandeln wir streng vertraulich

### Häufige Fragen zur Stelle als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Suchtbehandlung in Lenzburg

**Welche Ausbildung brauche ich für diese Stelle?**
Dafür benötigen Sie ein Diplom als Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder aber einen Bachelor in Pflege FH. Ausländische Abschlüsse sind mit SRK-Anerkennung ebenso willkommen.

**Ist mein ausländisches Pflegediplom in der Schweiz gültig?**
Ja, sofern das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK) Ihr Diplom anerkannt hat. Ausserdem beraten wir Sie gerne kostenlos zur Anerkennung.

**Wie schnell erhalte ich eine Rückmeldung auf meine Bewerbung?**
Meist hören Sie schon innerhalb von 24 Stunden von uns, denn Ihre Zeit ist uns wichtig. Zudem halten wir Sie danach laufend auf dem neusten Stand.

**Erfahre ich den Namen des Arbeitgebers?**
Ja – sobald wir sprechen, nennen wir Ihnen den Namen der Institution offen. Denn Offenheit gehört bei uns dazu.

description:

**Start:** Nach Vereinbarung

Kurz gesagt: Der Rahmen stimmt. Zudem lernen Sie nun den Arbeitsort besser kennen, denn genau darum geht es als Nächstes.
Hombrechtikon liegt am Greifensee und besticht durch seine idyllische Lage zwischen Zürich und Winterthur. Sie erreichen den Ort bequem mit der Bahn und dem Auto über die nahegelegenen Autobahnanschlüsse. Die Region bietet Ihnen als Arbeitsort eine ausgezeichnete Infrastruktur, qualifizierte Fachkräfte sowie die perfekte Balance zwischen ländlicher Ruhe und urbaner Nähe.

### Ihr Aufgabengebiet als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Berufsbildung in Hombrechtikon

- Sie tragen dabei die Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess, von der Erhebung bis zur Auswertung

- Zudem: Durchführung ärztlicher Verordnungen sowie sichere Abgabe der Medikamente

- Zudem überwachen Sie die Vitalzeichen, denn Sie erkennen früh, wenn sich etwas ändert

- Darüber hinaus leiten Sie FaGe, Pflegeassistenz sowie Lernende fachlich an

- Ausserdem lückenlose Pflegedokumentation im elektronischen System

- Zusammenarbeit mit Ärzteschaft, Therapien sowie Angehörigen auf Augenhöhe

### Das setzen wir für diese Stelle voraus

- Zuerst das Fachliche: die Ausbildung als dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder FH

- Bei ausländischem Diplom: SRK-Anerkennung zwingend erforderlich

- Zudem Erfahrung in der Langzeitpflege, Akutpflege oder Reha

- Vor allem Verantwortung, Empathie sowie eine belastbare, ruhige Art

- Dazu sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mind. B2)

### Ihr Arbeitsumfeld: Berufsbildung

Der Schwerpunkt dieser Stelle liegt in der Berufsbildung: Sie begleiten Lernende durch ihre Ausbildung, planen Lernangebote und nehmen Qualifikationen ab. Denn wer Nachwuchs stark macht, prägt die Pflege von morgen. Didaktisches Flair ist hier ebenso gefragt wie Fachkompetenz.

Kurz gesagt: Als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Berufsbildung in Hombrechtikon verbinden Sie Fachlichkeit mit einem Umfeld, das zu Ihnen passt. Genau solche Stellen vermitteln wir am liebsten.

### Der Beruf im Detail: Was macht eine diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH?

Als diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH tragen Sie die fachliche Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess. Sie erheben den Pflegebedarf, danach planen Sie die Massnahmen und werten die Ergebnisse aus. Zudem steuern Sie die Abgabe der Medikamente, überwachen Vitalzeichen und erkennen Veränderungen früh. Damit sichern Sie Tag für Tag die Qualität der Pflege.

Der Weg in diesen Beruf führt über die höhere Fachschule (HF) oder das Bachelorstudium Pflege (FH). Ausländische Diplome brauchen dafür eine [Anerkennung durch das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK)](https://www.redcross.ch/de/srk-anerkennung). Ausserdem stehen erfahrenen Fachpersonen viele Wege offen: ein Nachdiplomstudium (NDS), die Rolle als Berufsbildnerin oder die Teamleitung.
Die Nachfrage nach diplomierten Pflegefachkräften im Kanton Zürich und speziell in der Region Hombrechtikon ist derzeit sehr hoch, da Spitäler und Pflegeeinrichtungen kontinuierlich Fachpersonal suchen. Für Sie als qualifizierte Pflegefachfrau oder Pflegefachmann bestehen ausgezeichnete Chancen auf dem Arbeitsmarkt, mit vielfältigen Möglichkeiten sowohl in stationären als auch ambulanten Bereichen. iPersonal als spezialisierte Personalvermittlung erleichtert Ihnen den Einstieg erheblich durch ihre etablierten Kontakte zu lokalen Arbeitgebern, ihre umfassende Marktkenntnis und ihre persönliche Unterstützung bei der Vermittlung geeigneter Stellen.

### Ihre Vorteile mit MediPersonal in der Region Hombrechtikon

- Gratis-Weiterbildungen dank [Temptraining](https://temptraining.ch) – somit bekommt Ihre Karriere Rückenwind

- Eine feste Beraterin begleitet Sie persönlich, von der Bewerbung bis zum ersten Tag

- Dazu schnelle sowie ehrliche Antworten – meist innerhalb von 24 Stunden

- Faire Verträge nach GAV, denn Ihr Lohn soll klar und offen sein

- Zudem eine langfristige Perspektive, denn wir vermitteln Stellen, die wirklich zu Ihrem Leben passen

- Diskretion ist Ehrensache – denn Ihre Bewerbung behandeln wir streng vertraulich

### Häufige Fragen zur Stelle als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Berufsbildung in Hombrechtikon

**Welche Ausbildung brauche ich für diese Stelle?**
Dafür benötigen Sie ein Diplom als Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder aber einen Bachelor in Pflege FH. Ausländische Abschlüsse sind mit SRK-Anerkennung ebenso willkommen.

**Ist mein ausländisches Pflegediplom in der Schweiz gültig?**
Ja, sofern das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK) Ihr Diplom anerkannt hat. Ausserdem beraten wir Sie gerne kostenlos zur Anerkennung.

**Wie schnell erhalte ich eine Rückmeldung auf meine Bewerbung?**
Meist hören Sie schon innerhalb von 24 Stunden von uns, denn Ihre Zeit ist uns wichtig. Zudem halten wir Sie danach laufend auf dem neusten Stand.

**Erfahre ich den Namen des Arbeitgebers?**
Ja – sobald wir sprechen, nennen wir Ihnen den Namen der Institution offen. Denn Offenheit gehört bei uns dazu.

description:
Your Mission

As Head of Product Design & UX Research in General Marketplaces (Ricardo, tutti.ch, and anibis.ch), you will play a crucial role in creating a consistent, high-quality, and impact-oriented UX approach across our teams. You will lead Product Designers, UX Researchers, and a UX Copywriter, helping the organization accelerate discovery, improve design quality, and deliver measurable business impact.This role allows you to shape how design and research work at scale, embed AI-first workflows into our processes, and empower teams to create customer-focused experiences that build trust, improve conversion, and support monetization. Join our dynamic team, located in six countries (Switzerland, Serbia, Vietnam, France, Germany, and India), where creativity thrives. Together, we tackle challenges, celebrate successes, and keep learning and growing.
Specifically, you will work on:

• Define and implement a consistent design and UX approach across General Marketplaces.
• Lead, coach, and develop Product Designers, UX Researchers, and a UX Copywriter, fostering a high-performing and empowered team.
• Drive the adoption of AI-first workflows to accelerate research, problem discovery, solution discovery, prototyping, and design delivery.
• Improve the speed and quality of discovery and design processes across teams.
• Ensure strong customer focus by connecting user insights, research, UX decisions, and business outcomes.
• Raise the bar for design quality, usability, consistency, and measurable impact across our products.
• Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Data, and Business stakeholders to improve conversion, trust, user satisfaction, and monetization.
Your responsibilities will evolve as we grow.

Qualifications

What will you bring to the ride?

1. At least 5 years of leadership experience in Product Design, UX, or related disciplines.
2. Proven hands-on experience designing high-quality digital product experiences.
3. Strong customer focus and the ability to translate user needs into impactful product decisions.
4. An outcome-oriented mindset with a clear understanding of how design and research contribute to business success.
5. A strong business mindset, with experience improving metrics such as conversion, trust, user satisfaction, and monetization.
6. Experience leading, coaching, and empowering multidisciplinary design and research teams.
7. A pragmatic, hands-on leadership style with high standards for performance, ownership, and delivery.
8. Proven experience adopting AI-first ways of working and leveraging AI to accelerate research, design, and team productivity.
9. Ability to work in a hybrid setup based in Switzerland.
German and French are a plus, but not a requirement. We value the skills you bring and your ability to learn quickly, so don’t worry if your career path has been unique.

Additional Information

What do we offer?

• 6 weeks of holidays per year (plus the option to buy 10 additional days)
• 40-hour work week with flexitime (capped at 45 hours)
• A hybrid work setup with flexibility to work remotely
• Generous parental leave: 18 weeks for maternity and 6 weeks for paternity/adoption
• SBB Half-Fare Card and first-class travel between SMG offices in Switzerland
• Gender-neutral pay and transparent career paths
• Choose your gear: Mac or Windows laptop, and iPhone, Samsung, or Pixel mobile
• An inclusive and innovative environment where your voice matters

1. Initial Screening Call

Die Stadt bietet Ihnen ein vielfältiges Gewerbe- und Industrieangebot mit stabilen Arbeitsplätzen. Die gute Infrastruktur, die Nähe zu Bern und die hohe Lebensqualität machen Lyss zu einem attraktiven Arbeitsort für Pendler und Arbeitnehmer.

Zudem steuern Sie die Abgabe der Medikamente, überwachen Vitalzeichen und erkennen Veränderungen früh. So entsteht Pflegequalität, die ankommt.

Der Weg in diesen Beruf führt über die höhere Fachschule (HF) oder das Bachelorstudium Pflege (FH). Dafür benötigen Sie ein Diplom als Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder aber einen Bachelor in Pflege FH. Ausländische Abschlüsse sind mit SRK-Anerkennung ebenso willkommen.

title: Nurse specialist in dementia care
description:
To primarily provide holistic, evidence-based best practice care to a private individual relating to all her needs in positive person-centred manner. These needs currently include having a diagnosis of dementia, age-related frailties and any other issues or health co-morbidities that may arise.

Essentially the post-holder will be required to:

- Assesses; plans, develops and implements programmes of care; provides advice; maintains associated records either manually or digitally;
- Carry out nursing procedures as required and in concordance with clinical guidelines;
- Provide clinical supervision to other staff.

The post holder will direct, coordinate and supervise, where appropriate, the work of other staff to promote best practice in relation to the care of the client with dementia. In the absence of the team leader, the post holder will provide cover to ensure effective delivery of care to the client. Any issues should be raised with the line manager.

QUALIFICATIONS / Essential requirements

- Swiss or EU passport (or Swiss working permit holder)
- Registered Nurse with valid NMC registration or European/Swiss equivalent.
- Nursing degree or equivalent.
- Best Practice in Dementia Training completion or working towards, ability to undertake this.
- Willingness to undergo specific dementia training ie Best Practice in Dementia Care, delivered in English.
- Additional qualifications in relation to dementia and dementia related topics including stress and distress training, meaningful activity, Sage and Thyme.
- Understanding of the Newcastle Model and/or PINCHME model of behaviour assessment.
- Willingness to develop dementia knowledge as part of CPD either independently or as provided by the Organisation.
- Specialist dementia qualification or additional studies in related areas.
- Understanding behaviour as a communication and good knowledge of non-pharmacological interventions and strategies.
- Experience in End of Life Care / Develop relevant clinical skills to address any developing co-morbidities and end-of-life care

QUALIFICATIONS / Additional requirements (may be utilised to benefit LHS)

- Moving and Handling Trainer
- Beauty/Massage Therapy
- Meaningful Activity

LANGUAGE / Essential

- Ability to communicate effectively using English.    English as first language (ideally mother tongue). Local dialect to client – Central Scotland.
- Excellent written communication in English.
- Due to the nature of FTL Dementia the language centres of the brain are affected. The inability to communicate effectively has a detrimental affect on LHS and their quality of life, increasing stress and distressed behaviour.

EXPERIENCE

Minimum 5 years’ experience working with people with dementia.
    
PERSONAL SKILLS AND ABILITIES

- Demonstrate excellent team working skills with the ability to work using own initiative.
- Effective listening, communication, and interpersonal skills.
- Ability to work with people and as part of a multidisciplinary team.
- Excellent time management skills.
- Working knowledge of basic technology.    
- Teaching skills for junior members of staff, family and other professionals.

SPECIFIC JOB REQUIREMENTS

- Being able to commit to working a shift pattern based in Buckinghamshire, UK and Switzerland for extended periods of time (preferably 10-14 days) / Necessity to travel with the client in UK.
- Unsociable hours are included this comes in the form of a sleepover arrangement alternating nights with another member of staff for the period of time ‘on shift’.
- May involve accompanying client to and from other venues as part of the duties.
- Be able to conduct and present themselves in a manner appropriate to the social standing of the client.
- Confidentiality must be always maintained both in line with NMC requirements as well as organisationally given the nature of the employer – a confidentiality agreement will be provided separately.

title: Test & Measurement Engineer
description:
What you'll do
You will help design, integrate, and operate complex test and measurement systems in cryogenic, electrical, and controls environments. Your work will support the characterisation and validation of superconducting magnets and related components under demanding protection, synchronisation, and reliability requirements. You will join CERN's Beams Department, working in the Controls Electronics and Mechatronics Group and the Measurement, Test and Analysis section. The role involves developing modern control and data acquisition systems using LABVIEW, C++, Python, and CERN controls technologies.

Your responsibilities
Design, develop and validate software, controls and data acquisition architectures for superconducting magnet, cable and coil test benches, from functional requirements to acceptance tests.
Develop, maintain and integrate applications in C++, Python, LabVIEW and CERN controls technologies, including FESA/CMW equipment control interfaces for front-end and test-bench systems.
Integrate and support electronics, instrumentation, timing, interlocks, protection and data acquisition hardware on Linux-based, real-time and front-end platforms.
Operate, monitor, debug and improve complex superconducting magnet test systems, including cryogenic measurements, high-current/high-voltage tests, fast transients, quench detection and safe data acquisition.
Collaborate with CERN teams responsible for magnets, powering, protection, cryogenics, electronics and controls; document and present results, and promote good software engineering practices, including GitLab, code reviews, automated testing and clear documentation.

Your profile
Proven experience in C++ and Python software design and development for data acquisition, automation, testing, analysis or controls applications.
Experience developing software for hardware control and data acquisition systems, preferably on Linux-based, real-time or front-end platforms.
Knowledge of CERN accelerator controls concepts and technologies, such as FESA, CMW, device-property models, timing systems or equipment control interfaces, would be a strong asset.
Familiarity with electronics, instrumentation, signal conditioning, acquisition hardware and troubleshooting of measurement chains; experience with LabVIEW, LabVIEW RT or LabVIEW FPGA would be an asset.
Understanding of superconducting magnet or cryogenic/electrical testing challenges, including quench detection, high-voltage protection, electrical insulation tests, noise, synchronisation, interlocks and safe acquisition.
Master's degree or PhD or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, Applied Physics or a related field.

Your skills
Knowledge and deployment of computing hardware.
Testing and measurement of front-end electronics for analogue sensors and transducers.
Measurement and analysis of magnets.
Design, modelling and measurement of superconductors for magnets.
Works well in groups and readily fits into a team; participates fully and takes an active role in team activities.
Expresses opinions, ideas and suggestions with conviction and in a logical/structured manner; keeps to the point.
Produces workable and timely solutions that meet requirements.
Works conscientiously and reliably; delivers on promises.
Drives work / projects along and sees them through to their conclusion.
Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.

Medical hazard
Exposure to electromagnetic fields under certain exposure conditions.
Given the occupational health risks associated with this position, the selected candidate must obtain medical clearance before a contract offer is confirmed.

Employment conditions
Work in Radiation Areas.
Interventions in underground installations.

Be sure to meet the eligibility criteria
You are a national of a CERN Member State or Associate Member State. Currently, we cannot consider applications from Pakistani, Lithuanian, Latvian, Cypriot and Croatian nationals, as the ceiling defined under Article II.5 of the Associate Membership Agreement has been reached.

You have relevant qualifications and professional experience.

If you have previously held a Staff contract at CERN, you will not be eligible for these positions.

Please pay attention to the additional criteria and requirements for this specific position and mentioned above.

title: Hazardous Material Decontamination Engineer
description:
What you'll do
You will contribute to hazardous materials decontamination activities and civil engineering works and projects across CERN's buildings and underground infrastructures. In this role, you manage the preparation, coordination and follow-up of interventions, working closely with engineers, technicians, consultants and contractors to ensure safe and compliant operations. You are involved in both planning and on-site activities, combining technical coordination with hands-on follow-up. You will join the Civil Engineering section (CE) within the Site Asset Management (SAM) Group.

Your responsibilities
Act as the referent for pollutant-related works within the SCE-SAM group, managing the of hazardous materials decontamination activities at CERN.
Act as contract manager for hazardous substances decontamination frame contracts, overseeing budget, quality, schedule and safety, and managing financial variations, claims and settlements with contractors.
Serve as the referent of the civil engineering section for works and projects in technical galleries and the Proton Synchrotron complex facility.
Manage project design steps (preliminary, concept design, developed project design, building permit, technical specifications and relevant documentation for tenders and execution design) in collaboration with internal CERN entities as well as the consultants and contractors appointed.
Plan and manage the execution of construction and renovation projects, including coordination of various trades, utilisation of service and frame contracts and contract management, chairing site and coordination meetings, and monitoring cost, quality, schedule and safety until final acceptance.
Ensure compliance with safety and environmental rules and promote a strong safety culture on work sites.
Report on and document activities on a regular basis.

Your profile
Proven experience in the execution and/or supervision of hazardous substance decontamination works.
Demonstrated civil engineering experience in the maintenance and operation of buildings or infrastructures.
Experience in coordinating multi-technical trades across projects.
Experience on large-scale sites in industrial and/or scientific environments would be an asset.
Proven experience in in building construction or renovation projects would be an asset.
Experience in concrete and steel structure works would be an asset.
Master's degree or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Civil Engineering or a related field. Certification as a pollutant removal specialist, compliant with Swiss regulations and registered with SUVA and ideally a valid certification in "SS3 Technical Management" in accordance with French regulations and labour code.

Your skills
Hazardous materials response operations.
Knowledge of building construction, consolidation and renovation.
Contract management.
Organisation, planning and control.
Cost and schedule management.
Takes initiative beyond regular tasks and makes things happen.
Has a structured and organised approach towards work; is able to set priorities and plan tasks with results in mind.
Readily accepts new tasks or work/projects.
Utilises effective negotiation techniques to achieve long-term results acceptable to all parties involved.
Works well in groups and readily fits into a team; participates fully and takes an active role in team activities.
Spoken and written French, with a commitment to learn English.  

Medical hazard
Exposure to ionising radiation and classified as category A.
Exposure to electromagnetic fields under certain conditions.
Exposure to carcinogens, mutagens or agents toxic to reproduction.
Exposure to asbestos.
Exposure to lead.

Employment conditions
A valid driving licence.
Work in Radiation Areas.
Interventions in underground installations.
Work during nights, Sundays and official holidays, when required by the needs of the Organization.

La FER CIAM est l'agence genevoise de la plus grande caisse interprofessionnelle AVS de Suisse FER Genève, créée par la FER Genève et pleinement intégrée dans son écosystème de services aux entreprises membres.

Un périmètre technique exigeant, au service de milliers d'entreprises et de leurs assurés "” où chaque dossier a un impact direct sur la vie professionnelle et sociale des personnes concernées.  
Gestionnaire Contentieux \& Faillites  
Description du poste  
Votre mission :  
Au sein de la FER CIAM Genève, vous jouez un rôle clé dans la gestion et la sécurisation des créances des institutions affiliées. Vous pilotez les dossiers de contentieux, de poursuites et de faillites, assurez le suivi des procédures civiles et pénales ainsi que les actions en réparation du dommage, tout en accompagnant les affiliés et en collaborant étroitement avec les autorités et les partenaires internes. Gestion des procédures de faillite

• Suivre les procédures de mainlevée, gérer les correspondances et les frais associés et tenir un échéancier rigoureux des dossiers.

• Rédiger les plaintes pénales (CIAM et CIEPP) et suivre les procédures pénales engagées contre les entreprises et leurs organes  
• Imputer les paiements reçus dans le cadre des procédures pénales et des actions ARD, et suivre les arrangements relatifs à l'ensemble des procédures.

title: Systems Engineer
description:
ANAVIA is a Swiss aerospace company and global market leader in the development and manufacture of advanced unmanned vertical take-off and landing (VTOL) aircraft systems with a maximum take-off weight of up to 1,150 kg. Our dual-use helicopter platforms and sensors support a wide range of missions, including intelligence and surveillance (ISR), infrastructure inspection, cargo, and other critical operations.

Driven by a multinational and disciplinary team of highly skilled engineers in mechatronics, avionics, composites, software, flight testing, and industry specialists in marketing, manufacturing, flight operations and service, ANAVIA manages the entire product lifecycle in-house - from concept and design through certification, production, and global customer support.

Headquartered in Bilten and Näfels, Switzerland, and a wholly owned subsidiary in the United Arab Emirates, ANAVIA combines Swiss engineering excellence with a growing international footprint. Our reputation is built on technological innovation, operational reliability, and uncompromising quality. Supported by a robust European supply chain, we deliver mission-ready aerospace solutions that reflect the highest standards of Swiss precision and manufacturing excellence.


Your mission

Define and maintain the top-level aircraft system architecture, ensuring cohesive integration of all subsystems.
Perform functional decomposition of aircraft systems including avionics, propulsion, guidance & control, and payload integration.
Develop and manage top-level system requirements with full traceability to subsystems and mission objectives.
Provide oversight of Verification & Validation planning and execution, ensuring system-level requirements are verified and validated according to industry standards.
Lead interface management between mechanical, avionics, software, and payload subsystems.
Ensure regulatory compliance for UAV platforms, including SC Light UAS and other applicable standards.
Collaborate with design, manufacturing, testing, and operations teams to ensure compliance requirements across the UAV development lifecycle.
Guide and mentor junior system engineers, fostering a strong systems engineering culture.
Maintain and update system engineering artifacts, including architecture models, interface control documents, requirement specifications, and design rationale.
Participate in risk assessment, safety analysis, and airworthiness activities, ensuring robust and compliant system design.

Competencies & Duties
Working independently and responsibly. Perform tasks as described above.
Compliance according to ANAVIA’ employment contract, compliance with company’ safety instructions and employee’ safety requirements, compliance with employers’ quality manual, work instructions and corresponding process specifications and instructions.
International travel requires up to 25% of employee’ working hours.


Your profile

Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Aerospace, Aeronautical, Systems, or Mechanical Engineering.
Experience: 10+ years of experience in aerospace or UAV systems engineering, with strong exposure to system architecture, requirements management, and V&V. Proven track record in leading system engineering teams and defining aircraft system architecture.
Deep understanding of regulatory frameworks, including SC Light UAS and CS-27. Experience in requirements management tools (DOORS, Jama, Polarion, or equivalent). Familiarity with systems engineering standards (INCOSE, ISO 15288, ARP4754A).
Skills: Strong knowledge of Verification & Validation planning, testing, and integration.
High analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities. Ability to balance technical rigor with practical engineering constraints.
Strong attention to detail and capability to produce clear, high-quality technical documentation. Proactive mindset with the ability to drive system-level decisions and identify technical risks early.
Communication: Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, able to interact effectively with cross-functional teams and regulators.
Language: Proficiency in English (oral and written). German desirable.
Eligibility: Swiss or EU citizens only.
Location: On-site in Näfels | Bilten, Switzerland.

title: Trade Finance Solutions Operations Expert
description:
Trade Finance Solutions Operations Expert

Location: Geneva, Switzerland

At Bunge, Trade Finance Solution is far more than transaction processing. It is a critical function that supports financing of global commodity flows, business growth, and protects the organization from financial and operational risk.

As our Trade Finance Solutions (TFS) business continues to grow, we are looking for an experienced Trade Finance Solutions Operations Expert to join our team. Acting as a key control layer between commercial teams, banking partners, and operational execution, you will help ensure that complex Trade Finance transactions are appropriately structured, documented, risk-assessed, and executed in line with internal policies and international Trade Finance standards.

This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced Commodity Trade Finance Operations professional who enjoys solving complex challenges, influencing critical business decisions, being closed to the execution of the Trade Finance instruments and working at the intersection of banking, risk management, and global trade.

What You'll Be Doing
As a subject matter expert within the Trade Finance Solutions team, you will provide oversight, risk control, and advisory support for complex Commodity Trade Finance transactions.

Working closely with Commercial, Treasury, Legal, Accounting, Operations, and international banking partners, you will help ensure transactions are structured correctly, risks are understood and mitigated, and controls are maintained throughout the transaction lifecycle.

Your responsibilities will include:
Reviewing, structuring, and validating Structured Letters of Credit and Trade Finance documentation.
Providing expert advice on transaction structures, Letter of credit wording, risk mitigation, and compliance requirements.
Assessing and approving complex and non-standard transactions, including multi-bank and cross-border financing structures.
Acting as a key control layer between commercial structuring and operational execution.
Supporting and guiding global execution teams on complex transactions, exceptions, and best practices.
Collaborating with banks, clients, and internal stakeholders throughout the transaction lifecycle.
Monitoring transaction accuracy, financial flows, and operational controls by ensuring timely, precise and efficient execution.
Driving operational excellence through strong governance, stakeholder management, and continuous improvement.

Why This Role Is Different
This is not a traditional Trade Finance Operations role.
The team serves as Bunge's center of expertise for complex and Structured Trade Finance transactions. While standardized operational activities are performed by global execution teams, your focus will be on transaction oversight, risk assessment, decision-making, advisory support, and control effectiveness.

You will have the opportunity to:
Work on sophisticated Trade Finance structures supporting global commodity trading activities.
Partner directly with leading international banks and financial institutions.
Influence business decisions on high-value and strategically important transactions.
Act as a trusted advisor and recognized Trade Finance expert across the organization.
Contribute to the continued growth of a global Trade Finance Solutions business.

What We're Looking For
We're seeking an experienced Trade Finance professional who combines deep technical expertise with commercial awareness, sound judgment, and a strong control mindset.

Required Experience
6+ years of experience in Trade Finance within a bank, commodity trading company, or international trade environment.
Experience in Commodity Trade Finance.
Expertise in Letters of Credit, Stand-by LC and guarantees
Deep knowledge in ICC rules and their application (UCP 600, ISBP, ISP98, URC 522, Incoterms)
Experience reviewing and validating complex banking and Trade Finance documentation.
Strong analytical, risk assessment, and decision-making capabilities.
Experience working with multiple stakeholders across locations, functions, and cultures.
Fluency in English, both written and spoken.
Strong Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel and Word.
Experience coaching, mentoring, or training colleagues.

Preferred Experience

Structured Trade Finance or Transactional Financing products.
Receivables financing, collateral management, or loan administration.
SAP knowledge.
Additional languages such as French or Spanish.

What Will Make You Successful
You perform exceptionally well in complex, high-pressure environments that demand agility and sound decision-making. You consistently navigate competing priorities, balancing commercial goals, operational execution, and risk management while maintaining a focus on business outcomes. You are not afraid to roll up your sleeves, and actively contribute to execution when required to drive results and support your team.
You are a collaborative and adaptable team player who enjoys working across cultures and geographies and time zones. You value strong governance, standardized processes, and operational discipline while remaining agile and solution-oriented.

Why Join
This is a unique opportunity to join a global leader in agribusiness and commodities, to brin your expertise in Trade Finance and letter of credit and become part of a highly specialized Trade Finance team at the heart of international commodity flows.

In this role, you will:
Work on high-value, Structured Trade Finance transactions supporting global commodity trading activities.
Act as a trusted subject matter expert partnering with commercial teams, banks, treasury, legal, accounting, and operations.
Gain exposure to complex and non-standard financing structures, including multi-bank, cross-border, and tailored Trade Finance solutions.
Join a team that serves as Bunge's center of expertise, where technical knowledge, judgment, and advisory capabilities are highly valued.
Build a broad international network and collaborate with colleagues and external partners across diverse geographies and cultures.
Play a visible role in supporting business growth while maintaining a robust control and governance framework.
Influence operational excellence by helping shape standards, processes, and best practices across our global Trade Finance organization.
At Bunge, we believe our people are our greatest asset. We offer a collaborative, inclusive, and international environment where expertise is recognized, development is encouraged, and employees are empowered to make a difference every day.

Ready to Make an Impact?
Join us and help drive the successful execution of complex Trade Finance Solutions that support global business growth while protecting and strengthening our risk framework.
If you are an experienced Trade Finance professional looking to take on a highly visible and impactful role, we encourage you to apply via the link below and submit your CV in English. We look forward to reviewing your application.

title: Nurse specialist in dementia care
description:
To primarily provide holistic, evidence-based best practice care to a private individual relating to all her needs in positive person-centred manner. These needs currently include having a diagnosis of dementia, age-related frailties and any other issues or health co-morbidities that may arise.

Essentially the post-holder will be required to:

- Assesses; plans, develops and implements programmes of care; provides advice; maintains associated records either manually or digitally;
- Carry out nursing procedures as required and in concordance with clinical guidelines;
- Provide clinical supervision to other staff.

The post holder will direct, coordinate and supervise, where appropriate, the work of other staff to promote best practice in relation to the care of the client with dementia. In the absence of the team leader, the post holder will provide cover to ensure effective delivery of care to the client. Any issues should be raised with the line manager.

QUALIFICATIONS / Essential requirements

- Swiss or EU passport (or Swiss working permit holder)
- Registered Nurse with valid NMC registration or European/Swiss equivalent.
- Nursing degree or equivalent.
- Best Practice in Dementia Training completion or working towards, ability to undertake this.
- Willingness to undergo specific dementia training ie Best Practice in Dementia Care, delivered in English.
- Additional qualifications in relation to dementia and dementia related topics including stress and distress training, meaningful activity, Sage and Thyme.
- Understanding of the Newcastle Model and/or PINCHME model of behaviour assessment.
- Willingness to develop dementia knowledge as part of CPD either independently or as provided by the Organisation.
- Specialist dementia qualification or additional studies in related areas.
- Understanding behaviour as a communication and good knowledge of non-pharmacological interventions and strategies.
- Experience in End of Life Care / Develop relevant clinical skills to address any developing co-morbidities and end-of-life care

QUALIFICATIONS / Additional requirements (may be utilised to benefit LHS)

- Moving and Handling Trainer
- Beauty/Massage Therapy
- Meaningful Activity

LANGUAGE / Essential

- Ability to communicate effectively using English.    English as first language (ideally mother tongue). Local dialect to client – Central Scotland.
- Excellent written communication in English.
- Due to the nature of FTL Dementia the language centres of the brain are affected. The inability to communicate effectively has a detrimental affect on LHS and their quality of life, increasing stress and distressed behaviour.

EXPERIENCE

Minimum 5 years’ experience working with people with dementia.
    
PERSONAL SKILLS AND ABILITIES

- Demonstrate excellent team working skills with the ability to work using own initiative.
- Effective listening, communication, and interpersonal skills.
- Ability to work with people and as part of a multidisciplinary team.
- Excellent time management skills.
- Working knowledge of basic technology.    
- Teaching skills for junior members of staff, family and other professionals.

SPECIFIC JOB REQUIREMENTS

- Being able to commit to working a shift pattern based in Buckinghamshire, UK and Switzerland for extended periods of time (preferably 10-14 days) / Necessity to travel with the client in UK.
- Unsociable hours are included this comes in the form of a sleepover arrangement alternating nights with another member of staff for the period of time ‘on shift’.
- May involve accompanying client to and from other venues as part of the duties.
- Be able to conduct and present themselves in a manner appropriate to the social standing of the client.
- Confidentiality must be always maintained both in line with NMC requirements as well as organisationally given the nature of the employer – a confidentiality agreement will be provided separately.
- Understanding the culture local to the client and family as dementia progresses earlier years are more prevalent and a lack of awareness or understanding can cause increased stress and distress which could lead to unnecessary pharmacological interventions.    
- Housekeeping is also a key aspect of this position.

title: Internisten (m/w/d) für die umfassende Patientenversorgung in der Schweiz (Facharzt/-ärztin - Innere Medizin)
description:
Für mehrere Regionen in der Schweiz suchen wir zur erweiterten Grundversorgung von Patienten mehrere Internisten und Internistinnen. Die Kliniken, für die wir aktiv suchen, engagieren sich nach neuestem Wissensstand in der Inneren Medizin.
Indem sie sich mit anderen Gesundheitsexperten in der Schweiz vernetzen, ermöglichen sie eine umfassende und hochwirksame Versorgung. Man legt großen Wert auf medizinische Qualität und persönliche Behandlung. Dazu gehört, dass für jede Patientin und Patienten eine individuell abgestimmte Therapie ermöglicht wird. Die Bedürfnisse aller Patientinnen und Patienten stehen stets an erster Stelle.

Unsere starke Partnerschaft mit Kliniken aus dem ganzen Land ermöglicht Ihnen eine hochwertige Arbeitsumgebung und eine schnelle Anstellung.

Für mehrere äußerst interessante Arbeitgeber suchen wir per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung fachlich qualifizierte und engagierte Personen als

Internistin oder Internist für die Patientenversorgung in einem Schweizer Kanton Ihrer Wahl.

Zuständigkeiten / Hauptaufgaben

Die folgenden Punkte variieren je nach Standort ein wenig.

- **Diagnose, Behandlung und Prävention:** Internisten befassen sich mit der Vorbeugung, Diagnose und konservativen (nicht-chirurgischen) Behandlung von Krankheiten der inneren Organe. Dazu gehören unter anderem Herz-Kreislauf-Erkrankungen, Diabetes, Erkrankungen der Atemwege (Lunge), Verdauungserkrankungen, Nierenleiden, hormonelle Störungen, rheumatische Erkrankungen, Infektionskrankheiten und Bluterkrankungen.
- Patientenanamnese und körperliche Untersuchung:
Sie erheben eine detaillierte Krankengeschichte (Anamnese) und führen umfassende körperliche Untersuchungen durch.
- Anordnung und Interpretation von Untersuchungen:
Sie entscheiden, welche Labor-, bildgebenden (z.B. Röntgen, Ultraschall) oder funktionellen Untersuchungen (z.B. EKG, Lungenfunktion) notwendig sind, ordnen diese an und interpretieren die Ergebnisse.
- Erstellung von Behandlungsplänen:
Basierend auf der Diagnose entwickeln sie individuelle Behandlungspläne, verschreiben Medikamente und überwachen den Therapieerfolg.
- Betreuung chronischer Erkrankungen:
Sie sind häufig die erste Anlaufstelle und betreuen Patienten mit chronischen Erkrankungen.
- Beratung zu Krankheitsmanagement und Prävention:
Sie beraten Patienten umfassend zum Umgang mit ihrer Krankheit, zu präventiven Maßnahmen und zur Gesundheitsförderung.
- Koordination der Patientenversorgung:
Sie arbeiten eng mit anderen Fachärzten (z.B. Chirurgen, Kardiologen, Rheumatologen) und anderen Gesundheitsberufen zusammen, um eine ganzheitliche und interdisziplinäre Betreuung zu gewährleisten. Sie überweisen Patienten an Spezialärzte, wenn spezielle Behandlungen erforderlich sind.
- Notfallmedizinische Versorgung:
In der Notfallversorgung überwachen und behandeln Sie Patienten mit akut bedrohlichen Zuständen.
- Umfassende Betreuung:
Sie kümmern sich um Patienten aller Altersstufen, wobei besonders in der Praxis ältere und multimorbide Patienten (Patienten mit mehreren chronischen Erkrankungen) häufig sind. Sie sind auch in der Palliativmedizin tätig, um Patienten mit nicht heilbaren Krankheiten zu betreuen.
- Führungsverantwortung, Lehre und Forschung:
Sie übernehmen auch Führungsaufgaben in Kliniken, engagieren sich in der Ausbildung des medizinischen Nachwuchses und sind an wissenschaftlicher Forschung beteiligt.

Qualifikationen / Anforderungen

- Facharzttitel für Allgemeine Innere Medizin (AIM) gerne mit Spezialisierung sowie erfüllte Voraussetzungen für die MEBEKO-Anerkennungen
(EU-Facharzttitel, EU-Approbation und EU-Staatsbürgerschaft)
- Berufserfahrung mindestens 2 Jahre
- Freude an Teamarbeit, am Teaching von Kolleginnen/Kollegen in Weiterbildung und an konstruktiver, interdisziplinärer Zusammenarbeit
- Eine offene, kommunikative Persönlichkeit mit einer patienten-, kunden- und mitarbeiterorientierten Grundhaltung und hohem Engagement
- Erfahrung in einer angiologischen (Kader-)Stellung
Qualifikation für die Durchführung von PTA von Vorteil
- Interesse und Freude an interdisziplinärer Zusammenarbeit
- Die MEBEKO-Anerkennungen müssen beim Bewerbungsbeginn nicht vorhanden sein, jedoch beim Stellenantritt. Bei der Einreichung der Unterlagen kann auf unsere Erfahrung zurückgegriffen werden.
- Stilsicheres Deutsch, resp. C1-Zertifikat

Leistungen der Anstellung

- Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag
- Das Gehalt liegt bei ca. CHF 170.000,- bis CHF 200.000,- brutto pro Jahr bei Vollzeit und bemisst sich je nach Berufserfahrung, Aus- und Weiterbildung

title: Superviseur/e de Travaux en Electricité (H/F)
description:

- Réalise les relevés sur site et collecte les données nécessaires aux études et à l'organisation du chantier.
- Prépare les activités de câblage, décâblage, d'installation d'équipements électriques (analyse des besoins, définition des cheminements, listes de câbles et documentation d'exécution) et maintenance
- participe à l'élaboration de la documentation d'exécution.
- Contribue à l'organisation du chantier, l'organisation de VIC, l'établissement des documents et à l'élaboration du planning des travaux.
- Contribue à l'établissement des Work Dose Plans (WDP) pour les interventions en zones radioactives.

- Supervision des travaux
- Supervise les activités des contractants en charge du démantèlement, de la maintenance et de l'installation et de la mise en service d'équipements électriques, tels que les tableaux électriques, chemins de câbles et câbles de puissance et de contrôle, en veillant au respect des règles de sécurité, des spécifications techniques, de la qualité des travaux et du planning convenu.
- Veille au respect des règles de sécurité du client, des normes applicables et des documents de sécurité du projet (Instruction du responsable Sécurité Client, Safety Prevention Plan, rapport d'inspection VIC, etc.) ainsi qu'au respect des spécifications techniques (dossier d'exécution, règles générales d'installation, procédure de montage, normes, etc.).
- Signale sans délai au responsable Sécurité Client tout événement susceptible d'affecter la sécurité, la qualité ou le planning, et propose les actions correctives appropriées.
- Coordonne les activités de chantier en accord avec le responsable client, incluant celles apportées par les différents autres services (service transport, service échafaudage, etc.). Organise les réunions et inspections nécessaires.

- Reporting et documentation
- Assure une transmission écrite, claire et complète, aux Responsables clients et aux intervenants concernés, de l'état d'avancement des travaux et des points ouverts, ainsi que des informations et constatations relatives à la sécurité.
- Contribue à la réception des travaux et à la documentation « as-built » (annotations et corrections des plans et documents d'exécution à l'issue des travaux).

- Support technique et opérationnel
- Réalise des interventions et des travaux électriques et mécaniques de faible ampleur incluant notamment la
réalisation de mesures électriques et la mise en service d'installation.
- Réalise des travaux de consignation/déconsignation uniquement sur des équipements du Client en accord avec le Responsable Client pour les travaux qu'il supervise.
- Collecte, met à jour et gère les données techniques dans les outils informatiques du client

title: Hazardous Material Decontamination Engineer
description:
What you'll do
You will contribute to hazardous materials decontamination activities and civil engineering works and projects across CERN's buildings and underground infrastructures. In this role, you manage the preparation, coordination and follow-up of interventions, working closely with engineers, technicians, consultants and contractors to ensure safe and compliant operations. You are involved in both planning and on-site activities, combining technical coordination with hands-on follow-up. You will join the Civil Engineering section (CE) within the Site Asset Management (SAM) Group.

Your responsibilities
Act as the referent for pollutant-related works within the SCE-SAM group, managing the of hazardous materials decontamination activities at CERN.
Act as contract manager for hazardous substances decontamination frame contracts, overseeing budget, quality, schedule and safety, and managing financial variations, claims and settlements with contractors.
Serve as the referent of the civil engineering section for works and projects in technical galleries and the Proton Synchrotron complex facility.
Manage project design steps (preliminary, concept design, developed project design, building permit, technical specifications and relevant documentation for tenders and execution design) in collaboration with internal CERN entities as well as the consultants and contractors appointed.
Plan and manage the execution of construction and renovation projects, including coordination of various trades, utilisation of service and frame contracts and contract management, chairing site and coordination meetings, and monitoring cost, quality, schedule and safety until final acceptance.
Ensure compliance with safety and environmental rules and promote a strong safety culture on work sites.
Report on and document activities on a regular basis.

Your profile
Proven experience in the execution and/or supervision of hazardous substance decontamination works.
Demonstrated civil engineering experience in the maintenance and operation of buildings or infrastructures.
Experience in coordinating multi-technical trades across projects.
Experience on large-scale sites in industrial and/or scientific environments would be an asset.
Proven experience in in building construction or renovation projects would be an asset.
Experience in concrete and steel structure works would be an asset.
Master's degree or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Civil Engineering or a related field. Certification as a pollutant removal specialist, compliant with Swiss regulations and registered with SUVA and ideally a valid certification in "SS3 Technical Management" in accordance with French regulations and labour code.

Your skills
Hazardous materials response operations.
Knowledge of building construction, consolidation and renovation.
Contract management.
Organisation, planning and control.
Cost and schedule management.
Takes initiative beyond regular tasks and makes things happen.
Has a structured and organised approach towards work; is able to set priorities and plan tasks with results in mind.
Readily accepts new tasks or work/projects.
Utilises effective negotiation techniques to achieve long-term results acceptable to all parties involved.
Works well in groups and readily fits into a team; participates fully and takes an active role in team activities.
Spoken and written French, with a commitment to learn English.  

Medical hazard
Exposure to ionising radiation and classified as category A.
Exposure to electromagnetic fields under certain conditions.
Exposure to carcinogens, mutagens or agents toxic to reproduction.
Exposure to asbestos.
Exposure to lead.

Employment conditions
A valid driving licence.
Work in Radiation Areas.
Interventions in underground installations.
Work during nights, Sundays and official holidays, when required by the needs of the Organization.

title: Semiconductor Shift Maintenance Engineer – Implant 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
description:
The opportunity


Are you passionate about driving innovation and ensuring maximum uptime of semiconductor production tools? As an Implant Maintenance Engineer/Technician, you play a vital role in ensuring the availability, reliability, and continuous improvement of our semiconductor production tool park. Your focus is on the corrective, preventive and predictive maintenance of implant equipment, working cross-functionally to drive safety, productivity, and general tool and workflow optimizations across the production line.


How you’ll make an impact

Ensure maximum uptime of semiconductor production tools through proactive maintenance and troubleshooting of implant equipment

Drive continuous improvement in equipment performance, applying workplace safety and efficiency practices aligned with 6S methodology

Collaborate closely with other maintenance, process, and production teams to achieve performance goals and optimize line efficiency

Participate in tool upgrades and modernization projects to enhance tool capability and reliability

Maintain accurate and detailed documentation of maintenance activities, equipment status, and system performance

Support root-cause analysis and problem resolution for technical issues within the team

Train and mentor colleagues in the areas of implant, safety, and best maintenance practices

Promote a strong safety culture by ensuring compliance with all relevant regulations, procedures and documentations

Your background

Hands-on experience in maintenance of semiconductor production tools

Solid understanding of electronics, mechanics and pneumatics

Minimum 3 years of experience with ion implanters (such as AMAT or Nissin or Axcelis)

Familiarity with metrology tools for process control (Semilab WT-2000)

Additional training or expertise in vacuum systems or related technologies

Completed technical vocational training (e.g., Automation Technician, Electronics Technician, or similar field)

Willingness to work in shifts is a must

Strong team player with problem-solving mentality, organizational skills, and proficiency in English (German is a plus)


More about us


Hitachi Energy offers you interesting tasks in a highly motivated team and an open communication style. Through an individual and practice-oriented induction plan, we will support you to quickly gain professional confidence to be able to work independently with high level of personal responsibility.

You may request reasonable accommodations by completing a general inquiry form on our website. Please include your contact information and specific details about your required accommodation to support you during the job application process.
This is solely for job seekers with disabilities requiring accessibility assistance or an accommodation in the job application process. Messages left for other purposes will not receive a response.

title: Systems Engineer
description:
ANAVIA is a Swiss aerospace company and global market leader in the development and manufacture of advanced unmanned vertical take-off and landing (VTOL) aircraft systems with a maximum take-off weight of up to 1,150 kg. Our dual-use helicopter platforms and sensors support a wide range of missions, including intelligence and surveillance (ISR), infrastructure inspection, cargo, and other critical operations.

Driven by a multinational and disciplinary team of highly skilled engineers in mechatronics, avionics, composites, software, flight testing, and industry specialists in marketing, manufacturing, flight operations and service, ANAVIA manages the entire product lifecycle in-house - from concept and design through certification, production, and global customer support.

Headquartered in Bilten and Näfels, Switzerland, and a wholly owned subsidiary in the United Arab Emirates, ANAVIA combines Swiss engineering excellence with a growing international footprint. Our reputation is built on technological innovation, operational reliability, and uncompromising quality. Supported by a robust European supply chain, we deliver mission-ready aerospace solutions that reflect the highest standards of Swiss precision and manufacturing excellence.


Your mission

Define and maintain the top-level aircraft system architecture, ensuring cohesive integration of all subsystems.
Perform functional decomposition of aircraft systems including avionics, propulsion, guidance & control, and payload integration.
Develop and manage top-level system requirements with full traceability to subsystems and mission objectives.
Provide oversight of Verification & Validation planning and execution, ensuring system-level requirements are verified and validated according to industry standards.
Lead interface management between mechanical, avionics, software, and payload subsystems.
Ensure regulatory compliance for UAV platforms, including SC Light UAS and other applicable standards.
Collaborate with design, manufacturing, testing, and operations teams to ensure compliance requirements across the UAV development lifecycle.
Guide and mentor junior system engineers, fostering a strong systems engineering culture.
Maintain and update system engineering artifacts, including architecture models, interface control documents, requirement specifications, and design rationale.
Participate in risk assessment, safety analysis, and airworthiness activities, ensuring robust and compliant system design.

Competencies & Duties
Working independently and responsibly. Perform tasks as described above.
Compliance according to ANAVIA’ employment contract, compliance with company’ safety instructions and employee’ safety requirements, compliance with employers’ quality manual, work instructions and corresponding process specifications and instructions.
International travel requires up to 25% of employee’ working hours.


Your profile

Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Aerospace, Aeronautical, Systems, or Mechanical Engineering.
Experience: 10+ years of experience in aerospace or UAV systems engineering, with strong exposure to system architecture, requirements management, and V&V. Proven track record in leading system engineering teams and defining aircraft system architecture.
Deep understanding of regulatory frameworks, including SC Light UAS and CS-27. Experience in requirements management tools (DOORS, Jama, Polarion, or equivalent). Familiarity with systems engineering standards (INCOSE, ISO 15288, ARP4754A).
Skills: Strong knowledge of Verification & Validation planning, testing, and integration.
High analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities. Ability to balance technical rigor with practical engineering constraints.
Strong attention to detail and capability to produce clear, high-quality technical documentation. Proactive mindset with the ability to drive system-level decisions and identify technical risks early.
Communication: Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, able to interact effectively with cross-functional teams and regulators.
Language: Proficiency in English (oral and written). German desirable.
Eligibility: Swiss or EU citizens only.
Location: On-site in Näfels | Bilten, Switzerland.

title: Trade Finance Solutions Operations Expert
description:
Trade Finance Solutions Operations Expert

Location: Geneva, Switzerland

At Bunge, Trade Finance Solution is far more than transaction processing. It is a critical function that supports financing of global commodity flows, business growth, and protects the organization from financial and operational risk.

As our Trade Finance Solutions (TFS) business continues to grow, we are looking for an experienced Trade Finance Solutions Operations Expert to join our team. Acting as a key control layer between commercial teams, banking partners, and operational execution, you will help ensure that complex Trade Finance transactions are appropriately structured, documented, risk-assessed, and executed in line with internal policies and international Trade Finance standards.

This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced Commodity Trade Finance Operations professional who enjoys solving complex challenges, influencing critical business decisions, being closed to the execution of the Trade Finance instruments and working at the intersection of banking, risk management, and global trade.

What You'll Be Doing
As a subject matter expert within the Trade Finance Solutions team, you will provide oversight, risk control, and advisory support for complex Commodity Trade Finance transactions.

Working closely with Commercial, Treasury, Legal, Accounting, Operations, and international banking partners, you will help ensure transactions are structured correctly, risks are understood and mitigated, and controls are maintained throughout the transaction lifecycle.

Your responsibilities will include:
Reviewing, structuring, and validating Structured Letters of Credit and Trade Finance documentation.
Providing expert advice on transaction structures, Letter of credit wording, risk mitigation, and compliance requirements.
Assessing and approving complex and non-standard transactions, including multi-bank and cross-border financing structures.
Acting as a key control layer between commercial structuring and operational execution.
Supporting and guiding global execution teams on complex transactions, exceptions, and best practices.
Collaborating with banks, clients, and internal stakeholders throughout the transaction lifecycle.
Monitoring transaction accuracy, financial flows, and operational controls by ensuring timely, precise and efficient execution.
Driving operational excellence through strong governance, stakeholder management, and continuous improvement.

Why This Role Is Different
This is not a traditional Trade Finance Operations role.
The team serves as Bunge's center of expertise for complex and Structured Trade Finance transactions. While standardized operational activities are performed by global execution teams, your focus will be on transaction oversight, risk assessment, decision-making, advisory support, and control effectiveness.

You will have the opportunity to:
Work on sophisticated Trade Finance structures supporting global commodity trading activities.
Partner directly with leading international banks and financial institutions.
Influence business decisions on high-value and strategically important transactions.
Act as a trusted advisor and recognized Trade Finance expert across the organization.
Contribute to the continued growth of a global Trade Finance Solutions business.

What We're Looking For
We're seeking an experienced Trade Finance professional who combines deep technical expertise with commercial awareness, sound judgment, and a strong control mindset.

Required Experience
6+ years of experience in Trade Finance within a bank, commodity trading company, or international trade environment.
Experience in Commodity Trade Finance.
Expertise in Letters of Credit, Stand-by LC and guarantees
Deep knowledge in ICC rules and their application (UCP 600, ISBP, ISP98, URC 522, Incoterms)
Experience reviewing and validating complex banking and Trade Finance documentation.
Strong analytical, risk assessment, and decision-making capabilities.
Experience working with multiple stakeholders across locations, functions, and cultures.
Fluency in English, both written and spoken.
Strong Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel and Word.
Experience coaching, mentoring, or training colleagues.

Preferred Experience

Structured Trade Finance or Transactional Financing products.
Receivables financing, collateral management, or loan administration.
SAP knowledge.
Additional languages such as French or Spanish.

What Will Make You Successful
You perform exceptionally well in complex, high-pressure environments that demand agility and sound decision-making. You consistently navigate competing priorities, balancing commercial goals, operational execution, and risk management while maintaining a focus on business outcomes. You are not afraid to roll up your sleeves, and actively contribute to execution when required to drive results and support your team.
You are a collaborative and adaptable team player who enjoys working across cultures and geographies and time zones. You value strong governance, standardized processes, and operational discipline while remaining agile and solution-oriented.

Why Join
This is a unique opportunity to join a global leader in agribusiness and commodities, to brin your expertise in Trade Finance and letter of credit and become part of a highly specialized Trade Finance team at the heart of international commodity flows.

In this role, you will:
Work on high-value, Structured Trade Finance transactions supporting global commodity trading activities.
Act as a trusted subject matter expert partnering with commercial teams, banks, treasury, legal, accounting, and operations.
Gain exposure to complex and non-standard financing structures, including multi-bank, cross-border, and tailored Trade Finance solutions.
Join a team that serves as Bunge's center of expertise, where technical knowledge, judgment, and advisory capabilities are highly valued.
Build a broad international network and collaborate with colleagues and external partners across diverse geographies and cultures.
Play a visible role in supporting business growth while maintaining a robust control and governance framework.
Influence operational excellence by helping shape standards, processes, and best practices across our global Trade Finance organization.
At Bunge, we believe our people are our greatest asset. We offer a collaborative, inclusive, and international environment where expertise is recognized, development is encouraged, and employees are empowered to make a difference every day.

Ready to Make an Impact?
Join us and help drive the successful execution of complex Trade Finance Solutions that support global business growth while protecting and strengthening our risk framework.

description:

title: Nurse specialist in dementia care
description:
To primarily provide holistic, evidence-based best practice care to a private individual relating to all her needs in positive person-centred manner. These needs currently include having a diagnosis of dementia, age-related frailties and any other issues or health co-morbidities that may arise.

Essentially the post-holder will be required to:

- Assesses; plans, develops and implements programmes of care; provides advice; maintains associated records either manually or digitally;
- Carry out nursing procedures as required and in concordance with clinical guidelines;
- Provide clinical supervision to other staff.

The post holder will direct, coordinate and supervise, where appropriate, the work of other staff to promote best practice in relation to the care of the client with dementia. In the absence of the team leader, the post holder will provide cover to ensure effective delivery of care to the client. Any issues should be raised with the line manager.

QUALIFICATIONS / Essential requirements

- Swiss or EU passport (or Swiss working permit holder)
- Registered Nurse with valid NMC registration or European/Swiss equivalent.
- Nursing degree or equivalent.
- Best Practice in Dementia Training completion or working towards, ability to undertake this.
- Willingness to undergo specific dementia training ie Best Practice in Dementia Care, delivered in English.
- Additional qualifications in relation to dementia and dementia related topics including stress and distress training, meaningful activity, Sage and Thyme.
- Understanding of the Newcastle Model and/or PINCHME model of behaviour assessment.
- Willingness to develop dementia knowledge as part of CPD either independently or as provided by the Organisation.
- Specialist dementia qualification or additional studies in related areas.
- Understanding behaviour as a communication and good knowledge of non-pharmacological interventions and strategies.
- Experience in End of Life Care / Develop relevant clinical skills to address any developing co-morbidities and end-of-life care

QUALIFICATIONS / Additional requirements (may be utilised to benefit LHS)

- Moving and Handling Trainer
- Beauty/Massage Therapy
- Meaningful Activity

LANGUAGE / Essential

- Ability to communicate effectively using English.    English as first language (ideally mother tongue). Local dialect to client – Central Scotland.
- Excellent written communication in English.
- Due to the nature of FTL Dementia the language centres of the brain are affected. The inability to communicate effectively has a detrimental affect on LHS and their quality of life, increasing stress and distressed behaviour.

EXPERIENCE

Minimum 5 years’ experience working with people with dementia.
    
PERSONAL SKILLS AND ABILITIES

- Demonstrate excellent team working skills with the ability to work using own initiative.
- Effective listening, communication, and interpersonal skills.
- Ability to work with people and as part of a multidisciplinary team.
- Excellent time management skills.
- Working knowledge of basic technology.    
- Teaching skills for junior members of staff, family and other professionals.

SPECIFIC JOB REQUIREMENTS

- Being able to commit to working a shift pattern based in Buckinghamshire, UK and Switzerland for extended periods of time (preferably 10-14 days) / Necessity to travel with the client in UK.
- Unsociable hours are included this comes in the form of a sleepover arrangement alternating nights with another member of staff for the period of time ‘on shift’.
- May involve accompanying client to and from other venues as part of the duties.
- Be able to conduct and present themselves in a manner appropriate to the social standing of the client.
- Confidentiality must be always maintained both in line with NMC requirements as well as organisationally given the nature of the employer – a confidentiality agreement will be provided separately.
- Understanding the culture local to the client and family as dementia progresses earlier years are more prevalent and a lack of awareness or understanding can cause increased stress and distress which could lead to unnecessary pharmacological interventions.    
- Housekeeping is also a key aspect of this position.

Technical Support Engineer / E\-Mail Security (m/w/d)

Über 3\.400 Endkunden aus Branchen wie Medizin, Energie, Finanz\- und Versicherungswesen, öffentlicher Verwaltung, Pharma und Recht vertrauen auf unsere Technologie, um ihre E\-Mail\-Kommunikation sicher zu gestalten.  
Mit Sitz in der Schweiz und Deutschland verbinden wir die Präzision und Verlässlichkeit eines Taschenmessers mit deutscher Gründlichkeit. Unsere zentralen Werte – Offenheit, Zuverlässigkeit, Wertschätzung und Kompetenz – prägen die Zusammenarbeit im Team genauso wie den Umgang mit unseren Kunden und Partnern.  
SEPPmail ist Teil von Partners, einem auf Softwareunternehmen spezialisierten PE\-Unternehmen. Partners stellt ein ausgezeichnetes Netzwerk an Branchen\-/Industrie\-Experten zur Verfügung und leistet so einen erheblichen Mehrwert für die persönliche und unternehmerische Weiterentwicklung.  
Zur Verstärkung unseres Support\-Teams suchen wir eine service\- und lösungsorientierte Persönlichkeit, die unsere Kunden bei technischen Fragen rund um unsere E\-Mail\-Security\-Lösungen kompetent und freundlich unterstützt.  
Diese Stelle ist vollständig im Homeoffice zu besetzen \- Du kannst von überall in Deutschland oder der Schweiz aus arbeiten.  
Aufgaben  
Du übernimmst den technischen Support für unsere Kunden und analysierst und behebst E\-Mail\-Zustellungsprobleme, z.B. im Zusammenhang mit Blacklisting oder DNS\-Einträgen wie MX, SPF, DKIM und DMARC  
Du unterstützt bei der Konfiguration und dem Betrieb unserer Mailserver\-Lösungen, insbesondere auf Basis von Postfix, und arbeitest sicher mit Linux\-Servern (idealerweise Debian/Ubuntu oder CentOS/RHEL) auf Kommandozeilenebene  
Du hilfst Endnutzern auch bei grundlegenden Fragen rund um Windows\-Betriebssysteme weiter  
Du nutzt dein Verständnis von TCP/IP, DNS, Firewall\-Regeln und grundlegenden Netzwerkdiensten zur Fehleranalyse  
Du automatisierst wiederkehrende Aufgaben und die Analyse von Logdateien, idealerweise mit Shell\-Skripten (Bash), und nutzt bei Bedarf Grundkenntnisse relationaler Datenbanken zur Auswertung von Kunden\- und Systemdaten  
Du erklärst komplexe technische Sachverhalte verständlich und kundenfreundlich – sowohl gegenüber technisch versierten Nutzern als auch Laien – und dokumentierst Lösungen und Prozesse sorgfältig  
Du bringst dich aktiv ins Team ein, teilst dein Wissen mit Kolleg:innen und beteiligst dich proaktiv an gemeinsamen Projekten  
Qualifikation  
Deine Skills  
Must have: E\-Mail\-Protokolle (SMTP, DNS), Postfix, Linux\-Kommandozeile, Fehleranalyse bei E\-Mail\-Zustellung (Blacklisting, MX/SPF/DKIM/DMARC), Netzwerkgrundlagen (TCP/IP, DNS, Firewall)  
Nice to have: Bash\-Skripting, Grundkenntnisse relationaler Datenbanken, Grundkenntnisse Windows  
Dein Profil  
Abgeschlossene Ausbildung im Bereich Informatik, Fachinformatik (Systemintegration/Anwendungsentwicklung) oder vergleichbare Qualifikation, sowie erste Berufserfahrung im IT\-Support, idealerweise bei einem Internet Service Provider (ISP) oder im Hosting\-Umfeld  
Ausgeprägte analytische Problemlösungsfähigkeit sowie die Fähigkeit, auch unter Druck einen kühlen Kopf zu bewahren und logische Schlussfolgerungen zu ziehen  
Exzellente mündliche und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Deutsch und Englisch, ösisch von Vorteil  
Hohe Service\- und Kundenorientierung sowie ein freundliches, geduldiges und empathisches Auftreten – auch in schwierigen Situationen  
Verständnis für IT\-Sicherheitspraktiken, insbesondere im Kontext von E\-Mail (Phishing, Spam, Verschlüsselung)  
Teamfähigkeit, Freude am Wissensaustausch und Vertrautheit mit Remote\-Arbeit bzw. geografisch verteilten Teams  
Ausgeprägte Lernbereitschaft, Eigeninitiative und eine strukturierte, sorgfältige Arbeitsweise mit klarer Prioritätensetzung  
Benefits  
Eine verantwortungsvolle Position bei einem etablierten, PE\-backed Marktführer im Bereich E\-Mail\-Security mit über 25 Jahren Erfahrung  
Die Möglichkeit, im Homeoffice bzw. remote in einem verteilten Team zu arbeiten  
Kurze Entscheidungswege, flache Hierarchien und eine offene, wertschätzende Unternehmenskultur  
Raum für Eigeninitiative sowie kontinuierliche Weiterbildung in neuen Technologien und internen Systemen  
Ein Team, das Wissensaustausch und gegenseitige Förderung aktiv lebt  
Spannende, sicherheitskritische Produkte mit direktem Kundennutzen für namhafte Unternehmen und Institutionen  
Deine Perspektive  
Bei SEPPmail übernimmst du von Anfang an Verantwortung im direkten Kundenkontakt für Produkte, die täglich von tausenden Nutzer:innen europaweit im Einsatz sind. Du entwickelst dich fachlich weiter, vertiefst dein Know\-how rund um E\-Mail\-Security und Mailserver\-Technologien und wächst mit den Anforderungen unserer Kunden. Im Kontext des dynamischen Wachstums des Unternehmens ergeben sich perspektivisch Möglichkeiten zur persönlichen Weiterentwicklung und Karriereplanung.
